title: National Survey of People With Haemophilia in Portugal
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to implement a national survey to collect information regarding Portuguese people with haemophilia (PWH) on socio-demographic, clinical and psychosocial factors.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Haemophilia A or B
* Portuguese nationality

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acquired Haemophilia
* Psychiatric or neurological deficit
study_population: People with Haemophilia A or B, of any age and gender, registered in the Portuguese Haemophilia Association
